title: Margherita Pizza

items.prep: if frozen, thaw overnight in the fridge, then let it sit out at room temperature (favorite method: in the morning, put it in a small cooler with a towel on top and an ice pack)

instructions: Place a standard pizza stone on the center rack of the oven and preheat the oven to 500°F with the stone inside for at least 30 minutes.

Stretch the dough into a 14-inch round on a sheet of parchment. Spread with the marinara sauce, top evenly with the shredded cheese, and sprinkle evenly with the salt and pepper. Add any of the optional toppings (tomatoes, basil, fresh mozzarella, mushrooms, purple onion) if using.
Transfer the pizza and parchment to the hot pizza stone. Bake until the crust is golden and the cheese is beginning to brown in spots, 5 to 10 minutes.
Transfer the pizza to a cutting board, scatter over the basil if using, and cut into slices.
notes: Yidi's 2026-10-21 updates: no olive oil; Trader Joe's dough with overnight-thaw method; marinara added; shredded mozzarella; tomatoes plain (not beefsteak); tomato/basil/fresh mozzarella/mushrooms/purple onion optional; bake 5-10 min on a standard pizza stone.
